entries.0c0410ebfb96fcb8: Japanese companies with subsidiaries in China
entries.2710851ebc860696: Companies that outsource back-office work such as payroll calculation and year-end adjustment
entries.280c8a136dc5052e: The business is a single-segment operation centred on payroll-related services. For each of the payroll (bonus) calculation, year-end adjustment, resident tax and My Number collection tasks handled by personnel, general affairs and accounting staff at client companies, it proposes and provides made-to-order BPaaS tailored to each company's needs, offering business processes and technology together. Ei-Ko Information Technology (Qingdao) Co., Ltd. (100% voting rights, specified subsidiary), a consolidated subsidiary, is the outsourcing provider for payroll calculation work; Bizlight Technology Inc. (100% voting rights) is the outsourcing provider for software development; and Eiko Mirai Information Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (100% voting rights) provides "e-HR," a cloud-based personnel management system for Japanese companies with subsidiaries in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,345 million.
entries.3d93e4c95057cb75: This provides an ASP-based system that centrally manages information forming the basis for grasping attendance and for personnel evaluation. The consolidated subsidiary Eiko Mirai Information Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides "e-HR," a cloud-based personnel management system for Japanese companies with subsidiaries in China, handling payroll calculation, insurance enrolment management, attendance management and similar functions. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
entries.4b714a845aa6da81: This is a service that outsources various back-office operations of client companies. Currently, it outsources the issuing and verification of restaurant discount coupons. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.873b70f6baec9b51: Companies that collect employees' individual numbers
entries.a4a91ce4927a24c0: Companies that manage attendance and personnel
entries.a57229168c2ec0ab: This service receives the individual number provided by employees as required under the Number Use Act, confirms identity and the accuracy of the number, and converts the number information into data. It offers both collection by mail and collection through a cloud service. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
entries.ad0260fd1b5a5690: Companies with resident tax special collection work
entries.c06c4a8b6305f70c: The company mainly provides a cloud year-end adjustment service using its in-house HR-tech system "Kantan Nencho," and also provides data conversion services for tax returns and similar documents. The service is offered not only to customers of the payroll calculation BPaaS but also to customers who request only year-end adjustment work on a one-off basis. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
entries.c1cf778f89eb052c: A company that undertakes back-office work such as payroll calculation and year-end tax adjustment by combining cloud services with administrative outsourcing.
entries.c576294cc03fb92f: This service opens notices of special collection tax amounts, performs data entry, and inserts them into individual envelopes. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
entries.d1a3007b6718738c: This service covers payroll (bonus) calculation work, from proposing cloud services and supporting business process improvement to performing the clerical work on behalf of clients. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
entries.d95ce3ea88aa6481: Companies that require systems related to payroll calculation
entries.efda72b20a761d39: This service entrusts development and sales of systems attached to BPaaS. It provides systems for printing dedicated forms that match specific client requirements, creating data for accounting journal entries, and managing paid leave. The consolidated subsidiary Bizlight Technology Inc. also develops "Kantan Nencho," the year-end adjustment BPaaS. Amounts are not disclosed separately for each category.
